name: Fobos-1
about: Fobos-1 (1988-058A, IKI/BABTS), launched 1988 Jul  7. Its phases from GCAT: HCO, Mars. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was
the arc is solved from its ends (leaving Earth, meeting Mars on GCAT's date); GCAT gives no heliocentric orbit to check it against (solved: perihelion 1.015 au, aphelion 1.592 au)
